overview:
### CI-published test badge replaces hard-coded README numbers (Difficulty: 3/5)

This PR stops the README from going stale. It removes the hard-coded measurements (test counts, timings, byte sizes, Bun version, npm version) and adds a live test badge that CI produces. In CI, the `Test` step now pipes `bun test` output through `tee` into `$RUNNER_TEMP/test.log`, with `pipefail` so a failing run still fails the step. A new `Publish badges` step runs only on pushes to `main`, and runs even when earlier steps fail. It greps the last `N pass` / `N fail` lines from the log and writes a shields.io endpoint JSON. It then force-pushes that JSON as a one-commit orphan `badges` branch, using `GITHUB_TOKEN` with job-level `contents: write`. The README now points two shields.io endpoint badges at `raw.githubusercontent.com/.../badges/tests.json`, and the Numbers table lists only how to measure each value.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A["push or pull_request triggers CI job"] --> B["bun test 2>&1 | tee test.log (pipefail)"]
  B --> C["Doc-count drift guard"]
  C --> D{"always() and push event and ref == main?"}
  D -->|"no"| E["skip badge publish"]
  D -->|"yes"| F["grep last 'N pass' / 'N fail' from test.log"]
  F --> G{"fail != 0 or pass == 0?"}
  G -->|"yes"| H["color = red"]
  G -->|"no"| I["color = brightgreen"]
  H --> J["write badges/tests.json"]
  I --> J
  J --> K["git init -b badges, commit"]
  K --> L["git push -f with GITHUB_TOKEN to badges branch"]
  classDef chg fill:#d6ffd9,stroke:#1a7f37,color:#111
  classDef risk fill:#ffd6d6,stroke:#cc1111,color:#111
  class B,D,F,G,H,I,J,K chg
  class L risk
```

**Riskiest area:** the job now has `contents: write`, which also applies to `pull_request` runs. The publish step embeds `GITHUB_TOKEN` in the push URL and force-pushes a branch. Check that write permission and secret exposure are limited to the `main` push path, and that the force-push cannot overwrite anything except the `badges` branch.
